spine: 1. 論點：有效的 AI 安全不靠單一 frontier model，而靠一層 model-agnostic 的 orchestration——把 LLM 當可替換的 stateless compute、把 state 全externalise。
2. VDH 是八階段 pipeline（recon→hunt→validate→gapfill→trace→feedback→dedup→report），每階段都把結構化結果寫進一個 keyed (run_id, repo, stage) 的 SQLite，LLM 不持有 state。
3. 對抗式設計：Validator 的唯一工作是反證 Hunter，不能 file 自己的 finding；Hunter file 前必須先寫 threat model；output schema 的順序強制這件事。
4. VVS 用一個跟 VDH 完全不同的 model 做第二輪 triage；dedup 用 deterministic inverted index、reachability 用 MCP server 拉 prod context、fix 必須讓 regression test 從 fail 翻成 pass。
5. Production 數字證明 funnel 有效：20,799 raw → 12,057 survived（58% high-integrity）→ 7,245 actionable；rejection rate 從 40% 掉到 11%。
6. 反直覺發現：Semgrep 整個月零次調用、wishlist 是最常用的 tool（25,472 次寫入）、sibling forking 約佔 9% 的 fleet task。
7. 對工程師的 takeaway：要建 agentic security tooling，先把 harness 設計成 model-agnostic、state externalise、用對抗式驗證壓 false positive。

perspective.mechanism: 把 LLM 當可替換的 stateless compute、state 寫進外部 SQLite、用兩個不同 model 做對抗式 cross-check，是這套 vulnerability harness 能 scale 又壓住 false positive 的核心機制。
perspective.tradeoff: model-agnostic 換來的是放棄單一最強 model 的 peak capability，但換得 portability 與 cross-checking；對抗式 validator 多一輪算力但砍掉大量 vacuous finding。
perspective.reader_use: 建 agentic 工具（不只安全）的工程師可以照搬：state externalise、stage 之間用 deterministic 黏合、用第二個 model 當 validator、PoC 必須 fail→pass。

notes.quote: Recon — Maps out the target architecture and maps potential threat vectors; Hunt — Runs per-class attacks, compiles fragments, probes binaries; Validate — Mechanically checks the finding, then adversarially disproves it; Gapfill — Generates new hunt tasks for empty coverage cells; Dedup — Identifies and consolidates overlapping findings; Trace — Walks dependency graph; spawns consumer-repo tasks; Feedback — Learns from pre-existing reports and optimizes future runs; Report — Renders human-readable report
notes.interpretation: VDH 八階段名稱與職責。

notes.quote: We use one model for VDH, but we use a completely different model for VVS, so the models are effectively double-checking each other.
notes.interpretation: VDH 與 VVS 用兩個不同 model 互相 double-check。

notes.quote: deterministic code builds inverted indexes over the structured data (touched files/functions, trust boundary, rare tokens) to generate a short list of real candidates.
notes.interpretation: dedup 先用 deterministic inverted index 縮短候選。

notes.quote: The agent rechecks the latest information, pulling from deployment, environment, and config context to determine if the code path is reachable in prod.
notes.interpretation: reachability 靠 agent 拉 prod context 判 code path 可達。

notes.quote: A clean fail→pass flip is the ideal and the only auto-cleanup case; a failing post-patch test blocks the commit.
notes.interpretation: fix 唯一驗收是 regression test fail→pass。

notes.quote: 20,799 raw candidates generated by VDH
notes.interpretation: VDH raw candidate 總數。

notes.quote: 12,057 survived validation
notes.interpretation: 通過 validation 的數量；約 58%。

notes.quote: share of high-integrity findings climbed from 35% to 58%
notes.interpretation: high-integrity 佔比 35%→58%。

notes.quote: 13,841 findings across 145 repos in total
notes.interpretation: 總 bug 池 13,841 跨 145 repo。

notes.quote: 5,442 findings as duplicates
notes.interpretation: dedup 判為 duplicate 的數量。

notes.quote: 7,245 actionable findings for engineering teams
notes.interpretation: 最終交給工程團隊的 actionable finding。

notes.quote: initial validation rejection rate dropped from 40% down to 11%
notes.interpretation: rejection rate 40%→11%。

notes.quote: yields 100 initial findings ... 80 distinct, high-fidelity bugs
notes.interpretation: 單 repo 約 100 initial → 約 80 distinct bug。

notes.quote: The worst run took just over 14 hours
notes.interpretation: 最壞 run 14 小時出頭。

notes.quote: The wishlist has been written to 25,472 times
notes.interpretation: wishlist 被寫入 25,472 次。

notes.quote: its sole job is to aggressively disprove the Hunter's theory. If a Hunter is allowed to grade its own homework, it will confidently validate everything it outputs.
notes.interpretation: Validator 唯一工作是反證 Hunter。

notes.quote: A Hunter has to state the threat model before it's allowed to file anything.
notes.interpretation: Hunter file 前必須先陳述 threat model。

notes.quote: The output schema ordering enforces it. This requirement eliminates the vacuous findings.
notes.interpretation: schema 順序強制 threat-model-first，消掉空洞 finding。

notes.quote: Every confirmed finding ships with a PoC written as a test that runs against the original, untouched codebase.
notes.interpretation: 每個確認 finding 附跑在原始 codebase 的 PoC test。

notes.quote: Hunters invoked it zero times in a month of runs.
notes.interpretation: Semgrep 一個月零次調用。

notes.quote: The wishlist, by contrast, was the single most-used tool in the system.
notes.interpretation: wishlist 是系統最常用 tool。

notes.quote: Every stage writes to one SQLite database keyed by (run_id, repo, stage).
notes.interpretation: 每 stage 寫進 keyed (run_id, repo, stage) SQLite。

notes.quote: Fleet-wide, this accounts for roughly 9% of tasks, though the rate is highly model-dependent — from near-zero to about a fifth.
notes.interpretation: sibling forking 約 9%，high model-dependent。

notes.quote: models should be frequently interchanged and cross-tested. By varying the models across the pipeline — such as using one model for initial discovery and an entirely different one for validation — we can ensure that vulnerabilities are cross-checked by distinct sets of logic.
notes.interpretation: 論點：model 應頻繁替換 cross-test。

notes.quote: We broke this bottleneck by externalizing the state entirely, treating the LLM as a stateless compute engine.
notes.interpretation: state 全 externalise、LLM 當 stateless compute。

notes.quote: The harness is the bit that lasts. If you build your own system, design it to be model-agnostic from day one.
notes.interpretation: harness 才是會留下來的部分；要 model-agnostic from day one。
